summary: Verified runtime closure: durable commit intent before any routing publication, generation-checked deployment transitions with predecessor restoration, per-activation request leases with drain/cancel/safe-unload ordering, mandatory durable administrative audit with an explicit emergency-stop exception, enforceable inference budgets, production backend-identity admission, and automatic cold-start restoration that never confuses durable intent with live state.

repairs.title: Activation commit: durable routing authorization before any traffic
repairs.behavior: commit_activation() now runs a two-stage protocol: commit_activation_intent() atomically CASes the deployment record (generation, desired, previous, transition_id, phase, policy epoch) BEFORE the router publishes; the signed routing_observed event is recorded afterwards and is never described as pre-traffic evidence. A candidate receives zero requests before its durable commit intent exists.

repairs.title: Activation failure restores the predecessor — never an empty pointer
repairs.behavior: Unconditional clear_pointer() on activation failure is replaced by reconcile_deployment(): a generation-checked CAS that either restores the last committed live predecessor (RESTORED, with its own correct artifact digests) or durably records UNAVAILABLE at a new generation. Live router and durable intent are converged, never divergent.

repairs.title: Per-activation request leases; unload only at zero in-flight
repairs.behavior: The single global _inflight counter is replaced by per-activation RouteLeaseState (accepting/draining/inflight). abort() and quarantine_active() stop routing, drain the activation's own leases, and unload only at zero in-flight. A drain timeout triggers cooperative cancellation and retains resources — it is never unload permission. safe_unload() refuses while leases remain.

repairs.title: Production admission enforces backend identity and policy epoch
repairs.behavior: --production requires ProductionRuntimeConfig: signed backend manifest verified against the trust root, installed backend/dependency closure measured, operative policy epoch enforced, revocation evidence fresh and authentic at boot, runtime/admission signing keys role-checked, protected filesystem ownership verified, policy manifest and artifact stores must exist. Any failure refuses startup.

repairs.title: Mandatory durable administrative audit with emergency-stop exception
repairs.behavior: Privileged operations (launch/rollback/quarantine/recover) write signed, hash-chained admin_audit records (principal, operation, target, policy digest, decision, before/after state) before the side effect runs. Audit failure refuses ordinary administrative changes; emergency traffic shutdown still proceeds but blocks further activation until the audit trail reconciles (audit_broken flag cleared by the next successful privileged-op audit).

repairs.title: Enforceable inference budgets
repairs.behavior: InferenceBudgetPolicyV1 bounds prompt tokens (actual tokenizer count, not characters), generated tokens (clamped), concurrency (router lease acquisition refuses over-limit), per-principal queue depth, and execution deadline. PeftServingBackend.infer() enforces the bound inside generate() and reports applied-vs-requested metrics.

repairs.title: Automatic cold-start restoration
repairs.behavior: RecoveryManager.restore() validates the durable record, re-authorizes under CURRENT policy with a FRESH admission grant (a consumed grant is never reused), re-measures staged artifact bytes, loads without accepting inference, health-checks, then commits and publishes through the normal verified path. The service never declares ready merely because a pointer exists; permanent failure is durably UNAVAILABLE; restoration is idempotent and a serving supervisor is never re-restored.

journal_schema.deployment_record: deployments: deployment_generation (monotonic), desired_activation_id, previous_activation_id, transition_id, transition_phase (COMMITTING/COMMITTED/ROUTED/RESTORED/UNAVAILABLE), policy_epoch, last_committed_event_digest
journal_schema.admin_audit_table: sequence-chained signed records; verify_admin_chain() detects tamper

migration.v1643_to_v1644: AuthorityStore.__init__ migrates an existing v16.4.3 database: creates the deployments row seeded from the serving pointer (generation=1, phase=COMMITTED), creates admin_audit, leaves event history untouched. Covered by test_v1643_store_migrates_deployment_row.
